structure_policy_rationale: 参考主题中对于简单几何体（如支付宝的'支'字、豆瓣的抽象图形）均采取了严格的轮廓保留策略。醒图的核心识别度完全依赖于其独特的'发光球体'剪影。尽管原图标是平面的荧光绿渐变，但在主题化时必须将其视为一个具有物理厚度的3D冰球实体。必须保留圆形的完美曲率和内部垂直的光影分割线，仅将材质从'平面光效'替换为'立体冰块'。
preserve: 球体中央垂直向的光影/纹理分割
must_preserve: 球体中央垂直向的光影/纹理分割
recompose_allowed: 原本的荧光绿色泽（必须转为冰蓝/透白）
平面的光晕效果（转化为3D体积感和边缘折射）
黑色的背景（转为纯白背景）
restyle: 将平面荧光绿球体重绘为半透明冰蓝色3D冰球
将内部光影分割线转化为冰体内部的应力纹或折射光路
将边缘柔光转化为冰体边缘的 specular highlights 和 refraction
decorate: 表面添加冷凝水珠（condensation droplets）
内部嵌入微小气泡和雪花纹理（snowflake details）
底部添加接触阴影和微量融化水迹
forbid: 禁止保留原始的荧光绿色
禁止生成扁平的圆形色块，必须有明显的Z轴厚度
禁止丢失内部的垂直分割特征，否则会变成普通的冰球
禁止添加与修图无关的复杂装饰（如相机机身等）
禁止使用深色或黑色背景
generation_brief: 3D icon of Xingtu app: a perfect translucent ice sphere with significant thickness. Inside the pale cyan crystal, feature a distinct vertical refraction line or stress pattern mimicking a lens split. Surface has glossy highlights, condensation droplets, and embedded snowflakes/bubbles. Clean white background with soft contact shadow and melting water trace at base. No green color, no flat vector style.
color_application: Discard original fluorescent green. Apply uniform Pale Cyan/Ice Blue palette. Use translucency and subsurface scattering to define volume instead of color saturation.
stroke_application: Remove all 2D strokes. Define edges through 3D volume, beveled ice corners, and light refraction/highlights. Ensure smooth, rounded contours.
composition_application: Center the 3D ice sphere on a pure white background. Maintain the spherical geometry but add Z-axis thickness. Add a subtle ground shadow and water puddle at the base to anchor the object.
identity_application: Preserve the perfect circular silhouette and the central vertical structural division. Translate the original 'glowing' effect into physical ice properties (refraction, internal cracks/light paths) to maintain the 'lens/editing' semantic without using color.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified ice blue semi-transparent material, strictly no original brand colors.
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice crack textures.
Subject must present 3D volumetric sense, not a flat blue silhouette.
Background must be clean white to highlight translucency.
negative_constraints: No fluorescent green or warm colors.
No flat 2D vector styles or solid opaque fills.
No loss of the central vertical division feature.
No complex scene elements or camera hardware illustrations.
